lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with the highest-intensity maxima occurring in the mid-flank region posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like appearance where nodes correspond to the primary high-intensity centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a distinct vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow cast on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a distribution of approximately eight high-luminance spots of varying sizes, localized within the trailing edge and base of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density concentration of small, high-frequency white spots, notably smaller in diameter than the primary flank constellations.
